name: aaa vid to images
summary: a video-to-frame workbench with configurable extraction rate and image quality, saved job history, and a browsable frame gallery. perceptual hashing helps remove near-duplicate frames before further analysis.
problem: Make video frames easier to collect and browse for subsequent analysis, with control over how frequently images are extracted and how much duplication is retained.
highlights: Configurable extraction: Choose extraction rate and output quality to balance the number of images against the level of detail needed.
Frame gallery: Browse extracted frames in the web interface and return to saved jobs through the job history.
Near-duplicate filtering: Use perceptual hashes to help remove visually similar frames before further review.

sections.heading: The workflow
sections.body:
- Provide a video source.
- Choose the frame rate and quality settings.
- Extract images and filter similar frames.
- Browse the resulting gallery or revisit a saved job.

sections.heading: Under the hood
sections.body: A Flask application orchestrates yt-dlp and FFmpeg. Pillow and imagehash support image handling and perceptual comparisons.

sections.heading: Scope & current state
sections.body: A frame-preparation utility rather than a semantic video-understanding model. Sampling and similarity thresholds determine which visual changes are retained.
